$comment: Part I Section A — publication reference. The notice that identifies the procurement procedure. Hand-authored (not compiler-generated): Part I is administrative data, not a criterion. See docs analysis 'Part I Section A — Publication Reference (I68): Encoding Analysis' for the UBL/Schematron grounding.
title: ESPD Part I Section A — Publication Reference

publicationReference.description: A typed reference to the notice identifying the procurement procedure. Maps to one cac:AdditionalDocumentReference in UBL.

type.description: DocrefcontentType code identifying the kind/location of the publication that launched the procedure. The enum is the ESPD-allowed subset: DocrefcontentType.gc codes MINUS the governance exclusions (ESPD_REQUEST, epo-acc-espd-request — an ESPD Request is not a published notice that identifies the procedure). sectionA.test.mjs asserts it stays in sync with '.gc minus governance.excludedCodes'. Single source: model/codelists/governance.json.

allOf.$comment: ESPD Schematron BR-COM-10-01: when the referenced publication is a TED notice (Contract Notice TED_CN or Prior Information Notice TED_PIN), its identifier must be a TED OJ S publication number. Two forms are accepted: the eForms/TED number 'NNNNNNNN-YYYY' (1–8 digit publication number, a hyphen, and the 4-digit year; e.g. 310364-2026) and the legacy OJ S scheme 'YYYY/S NNN-NNNNNN' (e.g. 2015/S 252-461137; the temporary placeholder 0000/S 000-000000 matches this). Other publication types (national/regional/local journals) have no EU-standard identifier format and are left unconstrained.
